proposed_content.title: Shift Hash Brown Bacon Breakfast Buttie
method: Warm or toast the bap while you make the filling. Get the pan properly hot first. Cook the lean back bacon until browned and cooked through — colour is flavour, so do not crowd the pan.
Give the tomato/veg a minute in the same pan so it picks up the good bits, then add the measured sauce or seasoning and taste it.
Split the bap, build the filling while it is hot and keep the wetter bits in the middle so the bread stays intact.
Press it down, give it 30 seconds to settle, then get stuck in. If you are packing it, cool the filling before wrapping and refrigerate promptly.

proposed_content.title: Shift Hash Brown Bacon Breakfast Wrap
method: Get the pan to a medium-high heat and prepare the filling first. Get the pan properly hot first. Cook the lean back bacon until browned and cooked through — colour is flavour, so do not crowd the pan.
Add the vegetables and cook until softened but still with a bit of bite. Stir the measured sauce or seasoning through for the final 30–60 seconds so it coats the filling rather than burning.
Warm the wrap for 20–30 seconds so it bends without splitting. Put the filling just below the centre, fold the sides in and roll it up firmly.
For a better finish, put the wrapped seam-side down in the dry pan for a minute to seal and lightly crisp it. Eat while hot.
